explanation: Fixed two issues: 1) CL_S_COUNT and CL_M_COUNT parameters could be zero when S_COUNT or M_COUNT is 1, causing zero-width vectors. Changed them to have a minimum width of 1. 2) The m_ifaces generate block had numerous undefined signals and incorrect connections. Rewrote it to properly declare request/acknowledge/grant signals, instantiate the arbiter, mux data from the granted source, drive ready signals, and connect the output register. The new implementation uses grant_encoded to select the granted source's signals and generates request/acknowledge based on int_axis_tvalid and the muxed last/ready.
